correctness.rationale: A complete symbolic argument restricts a two-position attractor to four candidate pairs when the middle runs have length at least two, derives exact necessity and sufficiency for all one-change factors, constructs a three-marker cover for all positive lengths, and proves two disjoint lower-bound obstruction cones. A direct independent factor/occurrence implementation checks 1,296 bounded cases; finiteness is not presented as proof of the infinite parameter range.

evidence: A previously recorded exact theorem for periodic two-run powers \( (0^a1^b)^m \), whose \(m=2\) case is the symmetric slice of the present four-run family.
claim_vs_prior_implication.reasoning: The 2026 paper calculates minimum-attractor multiplicities for Fibonacci, period-doubling and (later) Thue-Morse words; the present family has unrestricted four independent run lengths and neither follows as a specialization of those fixed morphic sequences nor as a consequence of a universal value bound. The 2019/2021 material establishes background and methods but its inspected results do not entail the four exact conditions. The periodic two-run-power classification handles the strict two-parameter slice a=c,b=d; it cannot imply either of the unequal-run obstruction cones or complete unrestricted pair geometry.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: The exact claim is formulated both as size-two attractor existence and as complete coverage of all size-two attracting position pairs for a binary word with three alternations. The primary sources discuss general two-position attractors or other families but do not give the two obstruction cones or four sharp marker pairs. Generic size bounds do not determine these four-parameter cases.

originality.rationale: Comparisons against examined 2019 and 2021 structural sources, the recent dated 2026 primary paper on attractor multiplicities, targeted equivalent-language searches, and published mathematical-record summaries identified no exact four-run phase-and-pair theorem. No claim of exhaustive global priority is made. A previous repeated-two-run-power classification covers the symmetric specialization a=c,b=d (m=2), but not the four-parameter result.
residual_risks: An unindexed or inaccessible article could contain an equivalent characterization.

value.rationale: An exact infinite classification of all positive four-run binary words resolves the first natural alternating-run complexity layer with a genuine minimum-attractor jump from two to three. The enumeration of every nondegenerate two-position attractor and its two independent sharp obstruction cones supplies structural knowledge beyond an algorithm or isolated finite values.
